VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 12, 2024
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

Juanita Doplemore, Chair  Victor Hill, Commissioner
Kenneth Osborn, Vice Chair  James Schotter, Commissioner
Antawnette Atkins Blade, Commissioner  Nicholas Sramek, Commissioner
James Goodin, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Doplemore called meeting to order at 5:02 p.m.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith, Goodin

Also present: Gina Overholt, Coordinator.

Also in attendance: Jeff Williams, Christina Boatwright, Antawnette Blade, Vic Hill and Brian Heyman
with the local chapter of Vietnam Veterans of America.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Commissioner Antes led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-53820  Recommendation to approve minutes for Veterans Affairs Commission meeting on
  March 26, 2024.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Antes, seconded by Commissioner
  Shaknovich, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  7  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith, Goodin
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

2.  24-53821  Recommendation to approve minutes for Veterans Affairs Commission meeting on
  May 08, 2024.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Antes, seconded by Commissioner
  Goodin, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  7  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith, Goodin
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

3.  24-53822  Recommendation to receive and file the Chair’s Report for May 2024.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Smith, seconded by Commissioner
  Osborn, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  7  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith, Goodin
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  June 12 marks the 76th anniversary of the Women’s Armed Services Integration
  Act, which allowed women to serve as regular members of the Army, Navy, Air
  Force and Marine Corps.

4.  24-53823  Recommendation to discuss Veterans banners program.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Smith, seconded by Commissioner
  Doplemore, to approve recommendation to create a permanent veterans
  banners subcommittee. The motion by the following vote:

  Yes:  7  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith, Goodin
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Commissioner Smith, chair of Veterans banners ad hoc subcommittee, reported on
  the successful banners program, the high demand for it, and the need to find
  funding to continue the program in future years. Funding may come from the City or
  sponsors; a fee-based banners program may also be considered. The vision is for
  the banners to be displayed in every Council district. Staff reported that the banners
  have been positively received with honorees and their families contacting with their

  Page 2 of 4
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 12, 2024
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

  appreciation, gratitude and interest in a second round. The bios for the honorees
  are posted at longbeach.gov/veteransbanners. A “To/For/From” memo to Council
  and Department heads will go out this month.

5.  24-53824  Recommendation to discuss Honoring Our Heroes: A Sunset Ceremony.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Smith, seconded by Commissioner
  Antes, to approve recommendation. The motion by the following vote:

  Yes:  7  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith, Goodin
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Honoring Our Heroes was successful, well-attended and positively received. It was
  well-promoted in social media, flyers (distributed to various Veterans-related
  organizations) and e-mail invitations, and by word-of-mouth. Media coverage
  included a photo essay in the Press-Telegram, and a television news story (on
  CBS2).

6.  24-53825  Recommendation to discuss results of June 2024 survey of Commissioners’
  experiences.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Doplemore, seconded by
  Commissioner Antes, to approve recommendation . The motion by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  7  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith, Goodin
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Staff reported on survey progress, three responses to date, encouraged the
  remaining Commissioners to complete the survey as soon as possible, and briefly
  reviewed the required components of the Annual Report, which will include survey
  results.

7.  24-53827  Recommendation to establish an Executive Committee.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Antes, seconded by Commissioner
  Contreras, to approve recommendation. The motion by the following vote:

  Page 3 of 4
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 12, 2024
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

  Yes:  7  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith, Goodin
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Chair Doplemore proposed an executive committee comprising the Chair, Vice
  Chair, and City staff, as a permanent committee. Said committee will discuss
  meeting agendas, identify Commission and Office of Veterans Support priorities
  (and their alignment with the Strategic Plan), take the lead on planning a
  Commission retreat, and requesting additional funding to carry out goals, objectives
  and strategies identified in the plan. Discussion followed and the
  Commission agreed to cancel the July meeting because quorum will not be
  possible with four remaining Commissioners.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Jeff Williams, Director of Community Engagement for the Mayor’s office, presented certificates of
appreciation to the four Commission members who are exiting the Commission (because they have
served four consective terms): Commissioners Shaknovich, Ryan, Smith and Contreras. New
Commissioners will be appointed on July 16. Antawnette Blade inquired about survey data for
Honoring Our Heroes. Brian Heyman, first Vice President for Vietnam Veterans of America (Chapter
#756), invited Commissioners to attend their next meeting on Thursday, August 1, at 1 p.m. at
American Gold Start Manor.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

Housing Our Heroes event at Century Villages at Cabrillo on June 27 (presented by Orange County
Veterans & Military Families Collaborative), Third Annual Independence Day Dog Parade on June 29,
presented by Councilmember Mary Zendejas’s office, and 4th of July celebration and barbecue at the
VA Long Beach in Patriot’s Park. Commissioners were asked to nominate Veterans with dogs (either
as pets or service animals) to be honored at the event, as well to attend and table at the event.

ADJOURNMENT

Chair Doplemore adjourned the meeting at 6:11 p.m.
